name: How long does a tub to shower conversion take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a tub to shower conversion take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a tub to shower conversion project depends on its scope and complexity. A straightforward conversion, replacing a tub with a pre-fabricated shower unit without extensive plumbing alterations, can often be completed within 3 to 5 business days. Projects involving custom tile work, relocation of plumbing, or significant structural changes might take longer, typically 1 to 2 weeks, or more. We provide a detailed project timeline during the consultation phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: A straightforward conversion typically takes 3-5 business days; complex projects with custom work or plumbing changes can take 1-2 weeks or more.
